title: Emerald Pegasus Vortex
description: A vibrant green winged pegasus with flowing fiery mane and tail gallops through the center of a swirling red and orange vortex. Its wings are spread wide with green and orange flames trailing from the tips against a dark cosmic background filled with stars, comets, and glowing particles.
prompt: A powerful emerald green pegasus with large feathered wings and flowing fiery mane and tail, galloping dynamically through a swirling spiral vortex of red, orange and yellow energy. Flames trail from its wings, set against a dark purple and blue cosmic space background with stars, comets and glowing particles. Dramatic fantasy style with vibrant colors and high contrast.
